st: Ever more numb, apathetic and out of touch?

sec.p: Whether it's COVID, social media or because we only think about ourselves, we don't touch each other anymore (let alone have kids, 👵🏻ff.77.1 Is the “traditional family” a thing of the past?).
This very “touch famine” is at the heart of Out of Touch by Michelle Drouin, professor of psychology at Indiana University.
Abbracciamoci forte e vogliamoci tanto bene.Fabio Caressa

sec.t: ff.97.4 The economy and massage robots
sec.p: Touch famine, stress epidemic, social isolation and an ageing population: everything suggests that massage therapists will have a fortissimo future.
